levels.name: Named Juvenile Casebook
levels.description: For 5s after Shikanoin Heizou takes the field, his Normal Attack SPD is increased by 15%. He also gains 1 Declension stack for Heartstopper Strike. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.

levels.name: Investigative Collection
levels.description: The pull effect of the Arresting Windtunnel created by Windmuster Kick is enhanced, and its duration is increased to 1s.

levels.name: Esoteric Puzzle Book
levels.description: Increases the Level of Heartstopper Strike by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Tome of Lies
levels.description: The first Windmuster Iris explosion in each Windmuster Kick will regenerate 9 Elemental Energy for Shikanoin Heizou. Every subsequent explosion in that Windmuster Kick will each regenerate an additional 1.5 Energy for Heizou. One Windmuster Kick can regenerate a total of 13.5 Energy for Heizou in this manner.

levels.name: Secret Archive
levels.description: Increases the Level of Windmuster Kick by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Curious Casefiles
levels.description: Each Declension stack will increase the CRIT Rate of the Heartstopper Strike unleashed by 4%. When Heizou possesses Conviction, this Heartstopper Strike's CRIT DMG is increased by 32%.
